known_facts_book1: The people of the Munchkin Country, one of the four countries of the Land of Oz.
Uncle Henry is given nine suits of clothes cut in the popular Munchkin fashion.
Ozma offers to give Uncle Henry and Aunt Em a farm in the Munchkin Country or the Winkie Country.

known_relations_book1.Ozma: Their Ruler, among whose lands a home for Dorothy's uncle and aunt is offered.

not_in_this_book: the Munchkins are enslaved by the Nome King
the Munchkins wear only blue and are tiny

hallucination_signals: the Munchkins greet Dorothy in Munchkinland
the Munchkins are conquered by the Nomes

known_facts_book1: The people of the Winkie Country, ruled by the Tin Woodman as their Emperor.
Love their tin Emperor and keep him polished so there is no rust on him.
The Tin Woodman wishes he had been allowed to arm and drill his Winkies to fight the invaders.

known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler of Oz they serve.

the Winkies fight the Nome King in battle
